subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report access, scope clarification, and transfer options
messages:
From: Lisa Wu <lisa@acmepayments.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: engagements@bellamyaudit.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial SOC 2 Type II report request and scope clarifications

Hi Kimberly,

We're preparing for our vendor review cycle and need a copy of Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report covering the services used by Acme Payments. A few clarifying items from our side so we can align with procurement and security: 

- Please confirm the audit period covered by the report (start/end dates).
- If you can provide a bridge letter covering any gap between the report period and the current date, that would be helpful.
- We need guidance on your preferred secure transfer method for confidential reports and any evidence bundles. Our procurement team accepts SFTP, Box Enterprise links, or presigned S3 if encrypted.

We've attached a short request form that collects which control families we want evidence for and any particular systems in scope. Can you also point us to a standard reply or template your team prefers to provide?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Lisa Wu
Security Program Manager
Acme Payments
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: Acme_Request_Form_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Wu <lisa@acmepayments.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, engagements@bellamyaudit.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial SOC 2 Type II report request and scope clarifications

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear ask and the form. Looping in Grace (Security Ops) and Sean (Legal/Privacy) to help assemble materials.

Quick answers up front:
- Audit period: our most recent Type II covers 2024-07-01 through 2025-06-30.
- Bridge letter: we can provide a bridge letter that states there were no material changes to controls since the report end date and lists scoped exclusions. We typically issue a bridge letter signed by our Head of Security.
- Transfer options: we prefer an encrypted S3 presigned link or a dedicated Box Enterprise shared folder with account-level access controls. We can also do SFTP if you require inbound transfer.

What's included in a typical package we send:  
  - SOC 2 Type II report (PDF, auditor-signed)
  - Bridge letter (if requested)
  - Evidence manifest (CSV) that maps control IDs to artifact filenames and redaction notes
  - A small set of representative artifacts (config snapshots, access logs excerpts, table of key procedures)

Next steps:
1) Please confirm which control families Acme needs evidence for (CC1-CC7 or a subset) and whether you need system-level artifacts or only report-level confirmation.
2) Confirm preferred transfer method and a point of contact for access provisioning.

I'll attach an evidence_manifest_template and our redaction guidelines to make the transfer smoother. If you'd like, Grace can prepare a suggested minimal bundle for initial review so auditors can determine if they need deeper artifacts.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0123

Attachments: evidence_manifest_template.csv (csv), redaction_guidelines.txt (txt)

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, lisa@acmepayments.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, engagements@bellamyaudit.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 14:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial SOC 2 Type II report request and scope clarifications

Hi all — quick note with an attachable checklist and two short reply templates for Acme and your auditor. I recommend we offer a "minimal intake" bundle first (report + bridge letter + manifest + 3 representative artifacts) and then make the rest available on request. That keeps exposure limited and speeds review.

Minimal intake bundle (suggested):
- SOC 2 Type II report (full PDF)
- Bridge letter (signed)
- evidence_manifest_template.csv (populated for the minimal bundle)
- Representative artifacts: 1) IAM policy export (redacted), 2) One-week example of system access logs (redacted/time-window), 3) Change control ticket export for major infra changes

Suggested reply templates (attached as two snippets):
1) For Acme procurement (short):
"Thanks Lisa — we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter via an encrypted S3 presigned link. We'll upload a minimal intake bundle and share the URL with your security contact. Please confirm CC1-CC7 or a subset.
"
2) For auditors (more detail):
"Redwood will provide an initial evidence manifest and a set of redacted sample artifacts for control review. If deeper artifacts are needed, we will coordinate an incremental transfer window and a mutually agreed scope for additional evidence.
"
Operational notes:
- Redaction: we follow the attached redaction_guidelines.txt; sensitive customer PII is removed.
- Timing: We can prepare the minimal bundle within 3 business days of confirmation and access details.

I'll take the lead on packaging once we get confirmation from Acme on control families and the transfer method.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: intake_bundle_checklist.txt (txt)

From: Lisa Wu <lisa@acmepayments.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: engagements@bellamyaudit.com, security_ops@acmepayments.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial SOC 2 Type II report request and scope clarifications

Kimberly & Grace — this is perfect, thanks. A few confirmations from Acme: 

- Control families: CC1-CC5 are in scope for our review this round (we can escalate CC6/7 later).
- Transfer: Encrypted S3 presigned link works best for us; security_ops@acmepayments.com will be the contact to validate the URL when it's shared.
- Timing: minimal intake within 3 business days is acceptable.

Please send the initial bundle to security_ops@acmepayments.com and include engagements@bellamyaudit.com on the same link. If there's any problem with PII redaction, flag it in the manifest.

Would you also include a short one-paragraph boilerplate we can use in our vendor record describing the coverage (report period, bridge letter present, transfer method)? It helps procurement with filing.

Thanks again — Lisa

Lisa Wu
Security Program Manager
Acme Payments
